extracted.name: Martha's Spanish Rice and Sausage
extracted.description: Martha's Spanish rice and sausage recipe is basically rice simmered with chunks of smoky sausage and tomato sauce in this adobo-flavored one-pot dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound smoked sausage, cut into bite-sized pieces
0.75 (8 ounce) can tomato sauce, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in sausage; cook and stir until sausage is crisp. Stir in water, rice, tomato sauce, adobo seasoning, salt, and black pepper; bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes.
